versions.changelog:
Initial release of memory-digest skill.

- Generates human-readable weekly or monthly reports from an AI agent's daily memory logs.
- Summarizes activity with timeline, project status (new, ongoing, stalled), open threads, and changes in key metrics.
- Designed for scheduled or on-demand reporting; useful before planning conversations.
- Read-only and language-agnostic; works with any date-named daily log corpus.
- Explicitly notes if no activity is found in the report window.
